summary: More than one automation hub with the `file` storage backend needs shared storage, and RPM installs support only NFS. `/var/lib/pulp` must be mounted on every hub node before running the installer, or it errors that `/var/lib/pulp` is not detected; mount it everywhere and rerun.
questions: Which shared storage does HA automation hub support on RPM?
Can I use NFS for automation hub?
How do I set up storage for multiple hub nodes?
